id: Chopper — Gold-The Opera House, Wellington, New Zealand-Wellington NZ
name: Chopper — Gold
venue: The Opera House, Wellington, New Zealand
long_description:
Buckle up, Wellington — Chopper is back and not mincing words. The Australian comedian, otherwise known as Heath Franklin, is storming The Opera House with his new show ‘Chopper - Gold’. As usual, his take-no-prisoners sense of humour will be on display. For his 2026 tour, he’s delivering two decades of his funniest gags. Revisit sketches from The Ronnie Johns Half Hour: a comedy show Heath made with his uni mates. Expect a big dose of swearing with big hits like Harden the F*** Up, The Weather sketch, and Shopping at Bunnings. 

While Chopper has his tongue firmly in his cheek, the audience will be clutching at pearls in horror or clutching their sides in fits of laughter. When Chopper is not shocking crowds, he’s appearing on New Zealand television show ‘7 Days’. He also has a string of Australian television appearances.

id: The Beatles Anthology-The Opera House, Wellington, New Zealand-Wellington NZ
name: The Beatles Anthology
venue: The Opera House, Wellington, New Zealand
long_description:
Tribute band The Beatles Anthology is coming to The Opera House in June. For two hours, the show will take you down the long and winding road of The Beatles’ greatest hits. Expect the band to cover the era of matching suits and mop haircuts to the later experimental days. The four singers stand out for their authenticity and attention to detail, bringing the essence of The Beatles to life in every show. 

You might hear classics like Let It Be, Lucy in the Sky with Diamonds, and Yellow Submarine. Often regarded as the most influential band in popular music, The Beatles need little introduction. The Beatles Anthology brings a performance that captures the spirit of the Fab Four to Wellington audiences. This concert has the costumes, the hairstyles, the banter, and the gear. It’s not The Beatles, but it’ll feel like it.
